disease_profile.diagnosis: Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) infection, Chronic (Stage 3 / AIDS)
disease_profile.stage: Longstanding HIV. Diagnosed 14 years ago. CD4 nadir was 90 cells/uL with history of esophageal candidiasis and cryptococcal meningitis. Has been on multiple ART regimens over the years due to side effects and one episode of resistance.
disease_profile.treatment_regimen: Tivicay (dolutegravir) 50 mg + Descovy (emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide) once daily. Current regimen for 2 years. Previously tried Atripla (discontinued due to vivid dreams and depression), Kaletra (discontinued due to severe GI side effects), and Reyataz (developed resistance).
key_symptoms: Lipodystrophy -- facial wasting and abdominal fat accumulation (legacy of older medications)
Persistent peripheral neuropathy in both feet (burning, tingling)
disease_profile.trajectory: Virally suppressed for the past 2 years. CD4 has recovered to 385 cells/uL but remains below normal. Has lived through multiple health crises. Has multiple comorbidities managed by other specialists. Overall trajectory is stable but complex.

demographics.occupation: Peer support counselor at a community health center
demographics.marital_status: Divorced (ex-wife left after diagnosis), currently single

causes: Injection drug use in his twenties
Poverty and difficult upbringing that led to drug use
